description:
The new 26” woom OFF 6 provides off-road capability in a lightweight package with ergonomics that are designed specifically for children.
NOTE: You won't be able to upgrade the woom OFF to an air suspension fork later on. If you think your rider would benefit from suspension, consider the OFF AIR.

components.description: Chromoly axle and sealed industrial ball bearings
Hydraulic disc brakes by Promax; Rotor diameter front/back: 160/160 mm; Ergonomic brake levers designed for children's hands
Cassette with 11-36 teeth in the back
Narrow-wide chainring with 28 teeth in the front
Lightweight, forged aluminum 5.9" (150 mm) kid-specific cranks with narrow tread (Q-factor)
SRAM X5 rear derailleur
Ultralight carbon fork; 1 – 1 1/8" tapered steerer tube; 100 x 15 mm thru axles; Post mount for disc brake
Child-friendly thanks to small diameter; Single-clamp grip to prevent twisting; Safety zone: extra rubber on palm-facing portion of grip for added comfort; 100% silicone for maximum grip
Wide, ergonomically adapted and lightweight aluminum bars for more control; Tapered end to fit child’s hand; Sandblasted and silver anodized; Width: 665 mm; Rise: 20 mm
Fully integrated 1 – 1 ⅛" headset; Sealed industrial bearings
4 mm hex key for stem and seatpost clamp; 8 mm hex key for front wheel and pedals
Flat pedals made from fiber-reinforced nylon
Ergonomically designed to fit children's anatomy; Streamlined mountain-bike specific saddle design; Side protection to lean against walls
27.2 x 300 mm; Anodized aluminum seatpost with insertion marks that indicate the minimum insertion depth; Quick-release seatpost clamp
Quick-release seatpost clamp for easy adjustments; Made from aluminum
SRAM X5 trigger shifter
Forged aluminum; CNC-machined; Handlebars attached via two clamps; Rise/drop: +/-15° with flip-flop design to adjust handlebar height; Length: 50 mm

26 x 2.35″ Schwalbe Rocket Ron with ADDIX SPEED rubber compound; Quality mountain bike tires with low rolling resistance, maximum grip, good shock absorption and excellent durability; Presta valves, tubeless conversion ready

Tubeless-compatible Alexrims wheelset; Aluminum hubs with sealed industrial bearings; Thru axles for maximum torsional strength (100 x 15 mm front and 135 x 12 mm rear); 28 G14 spokes, triple-crossed spoking; Aluminum nipples
